test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The war _______ badly damaged the country’s infrastructure.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. has.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**has**" is used with singular subjects to form the present perfect tense.
 
• The subject **"The war"** is singular, so "has" is the correct form.
 
• The present perfect tense "has badly damaged" indicates that the damage occurred at an unspecified time before now and has a present relevance.
 
• The other options do not fit the grammatical structure:
 
 
• "**Have**" is used with plural subjects.
 
• "**Was**" is past tense and would require a different sentence structure.
 
• "**Is**" is present tense and would also require a different sentence structure.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
